description: Provenance + regeneration parameters for the painterly tileset (see README.md)
model: gemini-3-pro-image-preview (Nano Banana Pro) via Vertex AI, project hex-general, location global

tile_spec.hex: flat-top, point-to-point width 128 (2x render HEX_SIZE=32; drawn at 64 world px, crisp at MAX_ZOOM=2)
tile_spec.mask: hexgeom.hex_mask(128,128) core >128, dilated 1px (bleed) so abutting tiles overlap real content instead of AA fading

plains.gates: all 49 candidates passed luminance band 100-125 (measured 109-120); picks from a 23-candidate mutually seam-compatible clique (pre-v2 seam metric); truncation 0 fails

woods.class: object field (composited sprites; never swatch-cut - user: no cut-off canopies, trees end before the hex edge)

segmentation.connected_components: 8-neighbour, min area 400 px (prompt asked 6x6 grid but got 7 columns; components make the layout irrelevant)

compose.edge_inset: centre of crown must satisfy in_hex with shrink 2 + 0.72*max(w,h)/2 (no tree crosses the true hex edge)
compose.draw_order: sorted by y_base ascending (lower trees composite over higher)
compose.floor_discs: per tree, r=0.72*w at crown centre, rgba(30,44,26,185), gaussian blur 2, clipped to dilated mask
compose.placements: woods/placements.json (exact per-tree x, y_base, size, sprite index)

woods.ratified: 2026-07-01 via woods/review/woods-final-*.png ('sprites and layout are great' + packed density per 'can't really see much of the ground')

concept_anchors.note: luminance bands are anchored by MEASURING docs/concept-art/concept1.png, not by fiat
